dct_title_s: Cramer Quadrangle, Minnesota-Lake County, 1955: 15 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Cramer quadrangle topographic map (N4730-W9100/15) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink and pencil regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area north of Finland. The hand written notations include information on the following: Duluth & Northeastern Railroad line (D&NM), logging camps noted with 'C'.
